name: rhcsa-mock-exam
description: RHCSA (EX200) hands-on exam practice for Claude: mock exams, answer keys, read-only graders and coaching.

plugins.name: rhcsa-mock-exam
plugins.description: Generate timed two-node RHCSA mock exams with a separate answer key and a read-only bash grader that prints a Red Hat-style score report; write keys for practice tests you supply; grade attempts; coach individual objectives. RHEL 9 by default, RHEL 10 on request.
